response.consequence: Every SQL expression query fails at parse time, with the feature flag on or off. The flag has no effect, and the SQL expression feature is unusable.
response.explanation: enableSqlExpressions negates the feature flag (`enabled := !IsEnabledGlobally(FlagSqlExpressions)`). It returns false if that negated value is true, and it also returns false on the fall-through. Both paths return false whatever the flag says. ReadQuery's QueryTypeSQL branch now rejects every request with "sqlExpressions is not implemented", including when the feature flag is enabled. The inverted `!` also shows the intent was never implemented correctly. Separately, the new sql.DB stubs (TablesList, RunCommands, QueryFramesInto) always return "not implemented", so sql.TablesList in parser.go would fail every call. There is no work multiplier or unbounded loop on this path, so the performance hypothesis is not supported.
response.title: enableSqlExpressions always returns false, so SQL expressions can never be read
